title: 第46章 沙半鸡

第46章 沙半鸡-《赶山1957：二斤猪肉换个媳妇》

存书签

“大壮，二壮，赵红旗，今天晚上你们加个班，做几个笼子出来，以后狩猎野物咱们尽量狩猎活物，然后用笼子关起来暂且养两日，带回家后再宰杀。”

李青山开口吩咐道。

比如说獐子，狍子，貉子，麂子，野羊这些都能打到活物，等到这趟回去后，李青山打算去买几条猎狗，组成一个猎狗队，等从老林子回去的时候，就将这些活着的野物用绳子牵着，再让猎物驱赶调准方向。

一个人就能牵着好几只。

要不然，大壮一个人也就扛着一只獐子，最多再拿些什么工具，再想多拿几只野兔都不容易。

现在是夏天，不是冬天。

要是冬天的话，可以制作个撬板，在雪地上拉着走，也不用担心猎物的肉变质问题。

夏天打猎就是这样，局限性太高。

而且枝繁叶茂，也不好发现猎物，一般猎人都不太会选择夏天上山，也就是自己急需钱改变自己的家庭，否则自己也想等着冬天上山打猎多舒坦。

“山哥，笼子做成什么样子的？”赵红旗问道。

“架空地面两拳，留着缝隙给野物拉屎撒尿，咱们也好清理，笼子高度一米五，长两米，宽一米五，尽量选择粗一些的木头，缝隙要小一些，防止周围有野狼之类的东西。”

“这活不是一两天能干完的。”

“你们慢慢干！”

“有时间了，就把周围清理清理，从咱们村子走到这里要六七个小时，日后你们要是犯了什么事情了，你们躲在这里都不会有人发现。”

“这里是咱们第一处趟子房，等到这处的趟子房初具规模，周围野物也打的差不多了，咱们就继续深入十公里，再建第二个趟子房。”

李青山开口吩咐道。

“好！”

三人点头，开始忙活起来，李青山则是蹲在火堆旁，吃了两只烤野兔后，便打了几套养生拳，体内纯阳之气涌动，越发茁壮。

大概晚上九点钟左右，一行人便疲惫的躺在趟子房内睡了过去。

次日一早！

凌晨四点，老林子内的天空就已经清透，准备迎接第一天的狩猎时光。

李青山等人早已准备充沛。

经过一夜的休整，一个个精神百倍，十分亢奋，彷佛打了鸡血一样。

水獭肉已经在锅内沸腾。

八角，桂皮，姜片去腥后的复合香味，不断钻入李青山等人的鼻腔之中，实在是诱人。

一大早。

一碗肉汤下肚，鲜美无比，干瘪的身子立刻充盈了起来，活力更足。

“嗯，这味道真足！”

“要是冬天的时候，多放一些白胡椒粉，天寒地冻，一碗肉汤下肚子，那才是快活。”

"Dazhuang, Erzhuang, Zhao Hongqi, you guys will work overtime tonight and make a few cages. From now on, we will hunt as many live animals as possible, then lock them up in cages and keep them for two days, and then take them home and then slaughter them."

Li Qingshan opened his mouth and gave instructions.

For example, deer, roe deer, raccoon dogs, muntjacs, and wild sheep can all hunt down live animals. After returning from this trip, Li Qingshan plans to buy a few hunting dogs and form a hunting dog team. When he returns from the old forest, he will hold these living wild animals with ropes and let the prey drive them in the right direction.

One person can hold several.

Otherwise, Da Zhuang would only have to carry a deer on his back, and no matter how many tools he had to carry, it would be difficult to carry a few more hares.

It's summer, not winter.

If it's winter, you can make a crowbar and pull it across the snow without having to worry about the prey's meat spoiling.

That's what hunting in the summer is like, it's too restrictive.

Moreover, it is difficult to find prey due to the lush foliage. Generally, hunters would not choose to go up the mountain in the summer. That is to say, they urgently need money to change their family. Otherwise, they would like to wait until winter to go up the mountain to hunt more comfortably.

"Brother Shan, what is the cage made of?" Zhao Hongqi asked.

"Punch the ground above the ground, leaving a gap for wild animals to poop and urinate. We can also clean it up. The cage is 1.5 meters high, 2 meters long, and 1.5 meters wide. Try to choose thicker wood, and the gaps should be smaller to prevent wild wolves and the like around."

"This work cannot be completed in one or two days."

"You guys do it slowly!"

"When you have time, clean up the surrounding area. It takes six or seven hours to walk here from our village. If you commit anything in the future, no one will find out if you hide here."

"This is our first trip house. When the trip house here begins to take shape and the surrounding wild animals are almost hunted, we will continue to go ten kilometers deeper and build a second trip house."

Li Qingshan opened his mouth and gave instructions.

"Okay!"

The three of them nodded and started to work. Li Qingshan squatted by the fire. After eating two roasted hares, he performed a few sets of health-preserving boxing. The pure Yang energy in his body surged, making him stronger and stronger.

At about nine o'clock in the evening, the group of people lay down exhaustedly in the room and fell asleep.

Early the next morning!

At four o'clock in the morning, the sky in the old forest was already clear, ready for the first day of hunting.

Li Qingshan and others are already well prepared.

After a night's rest, everyone was full of energy and excited, as if they had been injected with chicken blood.

Otter meat is already boiling in the pot.

The compound aroma of star anise, cinnamon, and ginger slices, after removing the fishy smell, continuously penetrated into the noses of Li Qingshan and others. It was really tempting.

Early in the morning.

After a bowl of broth, it is extremely delicious. The dry body immediately becomes fuller and more energetic.

"Well, this tastes really good!"

"In winter, if you add more white pepper, when the weather is freezing, and you eat a bowl of broth, that will be a happy time."
